thesis: A single quarterly rebound does not offset H1 losses, negative FCF and 105x quoted earnings. Current evidence makes recovery a required assumption rather than a margin of safety.
strongest_counterexample: Q2 returned to RM9.91m profit and leverage is modest, so operating recovery may have started.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive FCF.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of operating margin above 8%.
evidence_gaps: Dated normalized earnings and investment-versus-operating cash-flow bridge.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: The latest quarter returned to profit
Returning to quarterly profit is a useful early signal, not proof of normalized earnings or positive investment-cycle cash flow
